name: Colonia Tovar German
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Only Wiesinger 1983 (German dialect subclassification) cited on Glottolog; no variety-specific phonology confidently identifiable

sources.citation: Wikipedia: 'Colonia Tovar dialect' (en), 'Alemán Coloniero' (de), 'Alemán coloniero' (es); Voz de América (2022) 'El alemán coloniero, un dialecto en peligro'
sources.note: No stress statement; es-Wikipedia lists a few segmental features (deutsch > [y], MHG consonant retentions) without sources for them; the bibliographies supplied the Blanco Hernández 1987, Da Rin 1995, Perkins 1978, Bondarenko 2010/2012 leads.

sources.citation: Louden, Mark L. (2020). Minority Germanic languages. In M. T. Putnam & B. R. Page (eds), The Cambridge Handbook of Germanic Linguistics, 807-832. Cambridge University Press. doi:10.1017/9781108378291.035
sources.note: Nothing on Colonia Tovar German; the only mention of Colonia Tovar on the Cambridge Core chapter page is the reference 'Da Rin, D. 1997. Das Deutsche in der Colonia Tovar (Venezuela). Munich: LINCOM Europa.'

sources.citation: Tehn Muttach, Abner J. (2019 [2017]). Traducción al español del análisis del primer capítulo y parte del segundo del libro 'La Colonia Tovar, Geschichte und Kultur einer alemannischen Siedlung in Venezuela' de Conrad Koch. Trabajo Especial de Grado (Lic. en Traducción), Escuela de Idiomas Modernos, Universidad Central de Venezuela, Caracas. https://saber.ucv.ve/handle/10872/19717
sources.note: Nothing. Full text run through extracted text and grepped (acento/tónic/sílaba/fonolog/Betonung): it translates Koch's HISTORY chapters; the only language remark is that c. 95% of the settlers spoke 'Alemannisch'.

sources.citation: Bondarenko Pisemskaya, Natalia (2010 [online 2020]). Situación ecolingüística venezolana contemporánea. Papeles de Trabajo (CEIEAS, Univ. Nacional de Rosario) 20: 22-35. doi:10.35305/revista.v0i20.114
sources.note: Nothing. Section 'El Alemánico' (pp. ~28-29 of the PDF) gives history, classification ('dialecto modificado del alemán superior... alto alemán', citing Gordon 2005) and vitality; the only phonetic remark is that the dialect 'ha conservado una serie de giros fonéticos y lexicológicos obsoletos'. It cites Redlich (=Perkins) 1978 as the linguistic study.

sources.citation: Blanco Hernández, Marlene (1987). Introducción al análisis gramatical del alemán de la Colonia Tovar. Tesis de grado, Universidad Central de Venezuela, Caracas.

sources.note: Grammatical analysis of the variety written in Caracas; may open with a phonological sketch. Not digitized in saber.ucv.ve; existence known only from Wikipedia bibliographies.

sources.citation: Da Rin, Denise (1997 [thesis 1995, München]). Das Deutsche in der Colonia Tovar (Venezuela) [Die deutsche Sprache in der Colonia Tovar (Venezuela): eine soziolinguistische Untersuchung]. München: LINCOM Europa.

sources.note: Sociolinguistic monograph (cited by Louden 2020, Cambridge Handbook of Germanic Linguistics); LINCOM volumes of this type usually carry a short structural sketch of the dialect that might state stress. No library record located online (DNB, WorldCat blocked).

sources.citation: Perkins, Renate Redlich (1978). Tovar German: Linguistic study of a nineteenth century Alemannic dialect spoken in Venezuela. PhD dissertation, University of Massachusetts Amherst, 415 pp.

sources.note: The only full-length linguistic description of the variety (Glottolog hhtype grammar); 415 pp. almost certainly include a phonology chapter with a stress statement. Harvard has online access via ProQuest (HOLLIS docid cdi_proquest_journals_302902759).
